content.text:
The coloured backgrounds are gone from the tabs in both the ribbon and the chat input. I also removed the tint from their bodies (the ribbon's command area and the chat input's box). With a plain selected tab sitting on a tinted body, you'd have seen a visible edge between the two. If you wanted to keep the body tint, say so and I'll put it back.

- **Chat input:** tab labels keep their mode colours, and the send button keeps its full-strength mode colour, so the mode still shows. The Code/Spec join and the chain tab's bottom border are unchanged.
- **Ribbon:** the Code and Spec tabs' labels are now in their mode colour whether the tab is open or closed. Before, the open tab's label switched to the normal text colour because the tint behind it already showed the mode.

The ribbon test that checked for the tint now checks that neither the tab nor its body is tinted, and it passes. There's no equivalent test for the chat input. I haven't looked at either in the running app. The rest of the suite has the same 4 failures as before, all from the code-to-spec and spec-reading prompt files not matching their tests, plus the answer-selection test, which failed in the full run but passes on its own.

The code changes are in `src/chat_input.rs` and `src/ribbon/mod.rs`. Both specs (`chat-input/index.pi` and `ribbon/index.pi`) still describe the tints, so they need a Spec pass to catch up.
